review_JOINT_NAMES: review the JOINT_NAMES list containing 49 joint names from OpenPose, LSP, MPII, and H36M datasets
review_JOINT_MAP: review the JOINT_MAP dict that maps 49 joint names to their corresponding SMPL joint indices
review_JOINT_IDS: review the JOINT_IDS dict mapping each joint name string to its numerical index in JOINT_NAMES
review_flip_permutations: review the SMPL_JOINTS_FLIP_PERM, SMPL_POSE_FLIP_PERM, J24_FLIP_PERM, and J49_FLIP_PERM left-right flip permutation arrays
review_joint_selectors: review the H36M_TO_J17, H36M_TO_J14, J24_TO_J17, and J24_TO_J14 joint selector index lists
